description: Retrieve detected mentions for a license the connected user is authorized to monitor. Detection is not proof of infringement. Use the external_id already named in the conversation (e.g. from get_public_license); don't ask the user to repeat it. Returns rows with source link, date, type and status, ready for a table. Optional page, per_page 1-100. Needs mention:read; if AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, explain WEIR AI needs account authorization, then retry the same request once connected. [Needs a connected WEIR AI account; scope mention:read]

external_id.description: external_id of a license from list_licenses.

name: list_license_mentions
title: List detected mentions
